scope: Conceptual model only; no physical tables, production implementation or native acceptance asserted.

identity_policy.world_definition: One independent game save, continuous across seasons
identity_policy.world_vs_instance_reason: DEV14 reset replaces save_instance_id as well as generation_id; stable basketball world identity must not alias that changing token.
identity_policy.reset_continuity: explicit same-game-save evidence required; otherwise HOLD; distinct save requires a fresh unrelated world_id

common_fact_fields.business_id: application ID, never pointer/name or batch ID
common_fact_fields.revision: immutable assertion revision; does not create a new basketball event
common_fact_fields.valid_time: known/unknown game effective instant or interval
common_fact_fields.source_refs: nonempty observation/manifest/receipt refs for factual assertion
common_fact_fields.evidence_labels: independent per-field labels; no single ordered DONE

query_policy.role_scope: same world plus actor subject and as_of; generic SQL/raw joins prohibited

HUMAN.supports: Independent saves, no branches or inheritance, full domain model and six scenarios.

DEV14.supports: create/adopt generate instance and generation; reset replaces BOTH; archives and lifecycle guards.

SAVEPATH.supports: save_id is a validated directory locator; paths follow manifest data_directory.

CAPTURE.supports: Complete cohort and source metadata binding; publication recovery.

M0.supports: Snapshot-bound views; potential_v1 GM_SANITIZED check; roster-slot identities are snapshot local.

LEGACY.supports: Existing teams/players/contracts/monthly/season/history/assets schema, not observed live facts.

SOURCE.supports: Snapshot and roster-slot keyed source observations; field decoding.

AGC.supports: Record book and dictionaries; Slot44 schedule claim superseded by AGD.

AGD.supports: SEASON/24B Box/48B season totals/career links and Slot44 matchup interpretation; pending independent acceptance.

BOX.supports: Candidate fields/flags/indexes; formulas in decoder are derived, not automatic native truth.

TOTALS.supports: 48-byte totals and uint16 career slots; 7-bit season code and bounded historical loop need future-year validation.

AUDIT.supports: 40 capability families, independent maturity axes; not AGD acceptance.

entities.definition: 一个独立 NBA2K22 游戏存档所代表的连续篮球世界；不是存档文件路径或备份文件。
entities.lifecycle: registered -> active -> retired; retirement retains history
unknown_fields: physical save identity is not auto-readable; enrollment needs explicit binding

entities.definition: 世界与一次 DEV14 物理工作区实例/技术代际的绑定；是安全边界而非世界分支。
entities.lifecycle: prepared -> active -> sealed/blocked; append new binding on reset
unknown_fields: same-save continuity after reset must be proved; never infer from save_id

entities.definition: 一个世界内的赛季周期；年份标签仅为属性。
entities.lifecycle: scheduled -> active -> completed -> archived
unknown_fields: native season encoding after 2027 and historical coverage

entities.definition: 赛季中有来源的阶段及有效区间。
entities.lifecycle: observed intervals; corrections versioned
unknown_fields: exact native phase transition/source

entities.definition: 某赛季已观察到的赛程视图及版本，不将缺少日期的比赛补造为日历事件。
entities.lifecycle: versioned season calendar projection; not event creator
unknown_fields: Slot10 versus SEASON schedule relation; cancelled/postponed identities

entities.definition: 一次被明确绑定到存档和技术代际的采集执行及其完整性边界。
entities.lifecycle: staged -> validated -> published or rejected; immutable publication manifest
unknown_fields: physical format and scheduling remain SCHEMA/INGEST tasks

entities.definition: 世界内长期球队组织身份，可跨赛季更名或迁址；原生槽位不等于此身份。
entities.lifecycle: registered through rename/relocation; retired identity retained
unknown_fields: expansion/rebranding native identity continuity

entities.definition: 长期球队在一个赛季/竞赛中的参与身份与状态容器。
entities.lifecycle: one franchise participation per season and competition; observed state versions
unknown_fields: competition and G-League affiliations

entities.definition: 某个存档内实际存在的一名球员及其连续生涯；球员姓名和历史模板都不是身份。
entities.lifecycle: registered -> active -> retired; stable across season and trade
unknown_fields: PlayerID reuse and cross-season continuity; ambiguous observations quarantined

entities.definition: 可跨存档复用的版本化静态选秀素材；不含游戏实例的历史、记忆或成长。
entities.lifecycle: versioned reusable static resource; no world facts/memories
unknown_fields: template import matching; no career/ability future leakage to role views

entities.definition: 世界内工作人员身份；Coach 是岗位，换队不自动产生新人。
entities.lifecycle: registered -> employed/unemployed -> retired
unknown_fields: staff identity reuse and player-to-staff conversion

entities.definition: 球员在球队赛季中某种名单角色的有时效归属；合同球队可能与出场球队不同。
entities.lifecycle: effective intervals; end on trade/waive, never rewrite prior membership
unknown_fields: trade instant when only snapshot observations exist

entities.definition: 球员与组织之间的一份有来源的合同及修订历史。
entities.lifecycle: observed -> active -> amended/terminated/expired; amendments retain versions
unknown_fields: multi-team obligations, options, contract identity source

entities.definition: 合同在具体游戏赛季的薪资义务、保障及选项观察。
entities.lifecycle: per-contract season obligations and versioned observations
unknown_fields: salary units and option semantics must retain source certification

entities.definition: 球队在某赛季的裁员残留薪资义务，不等同球员现行合同。
entities.lifecycle: observed liability -> settled/expired; prior balances retained
unknown_fields: is_stretched_heuristic is derived, not native flag

entities.definition: 以本世界未来选秀赛季、轮次和原始球队定义语义的资产；归属变化不改变资产身份。
entities.lifecycle: created -> transferred -> exercised/expired; stable asset
unknown_fields: protections/swaps cannot be inferred from simple owner

entities.definition: 选秀权的有时效归属与附带条件；不臆造保护或互换权。
entities.lifecycle: effective owner intervals; condition versions retained
unknown_fields: complex contingent rights and exact transfer time

entities.definition: 球队赛季财务在指定时点的观察；原生金额和公式估算分字段标记。
entities.lifecycle: append observations, retain source version and effective time
unknown_fields: some legacy finance fields are formulas rather than observed balances

entities.definition: 已发生的交易、签约或选秀事件的有证据断言；提案不能成为此事件。
entities.lifecycle: candidate observation -> identity/source resolved -> recorded; corrections versioned
unknown_fields: snapshot roster delta alone cannot prove trade/signing details

entities.definition: 工作人员在球队赛季中担任岗位的有效区间及条款。
entities.lifecycle: effective team-role interval with observed terms
unknown_fields: precise hiring/firing event and concurrent roles

entities.definition: 世界内赛季与竞赛中的一次比赛身份；赛程、进行中和终局是状态而非三个事件。
entities.lifecycle: scheduled -> in_progress -> final; cancel/postpone/unknown retained as versioned observations
unknown_fields: GameID scope/reuse, repeated fixtures and current flags

entities.definition: 某队在某场比赛的一份结果版本，包括主客方、比分和结果状态。
entities.lifecycle: one per game/team/result revision; only resolved final games yield wins
unknown_fields: overtime limits, scores/status, tied/unplayed winner must remain unknown

entities.definition: 球员为比赛当时球队出场的统计断言，保留未出场和未观察的差别。
entities.lifecycle: game/player/team observation versions; never follow player's current team
unknown_fields: StatBank bounds/InUse, player lookup, DNP versus unobserved

entities.definition: 同一比赛修订版本下的双方结果和球员统计聚合，完整性必须显式声明。
entities.lifecycle: immutable game revision aggregate; may be partial
unknown_fields: complete game/team/player cohort coverage

entities.definition: 原生赛季累计观察；包括主体、赛季、竞赛、球队口径和截至时间。
entities.lifecycle: append native cumulative observations per subject/season/competition/stint
unknown_fields: team stint vs whole-season meaning and additive eligibility

entities.definition: 球员与已有原生历史赛季记录的有证据关联；不是全部职业生涯完整性的承诺。
entities.lifecycle: links native history observations to resolved player/season; retains missing history
unknown_fields: 20-loop/sentinel boundaries, chronology and retired-player persistence

entities.definition: 原生纪录簿的一条观察，区分内置真实 NBA 历史与该存档产生的纪录。
entities.lifecycle: versioned native record observations; world history distinguished from built-in real history
unknown_fields: preseeded NBA record not proof event occurred in this save; flags unresolved

entities.definition: 指定世界赛季中的有证据奖项事件及获奖主体。
entities.lifecycle: observed season award event; correction retains prior winner assertion
unknown_fields: native award source and individual/team recipient resolution

entities.definition: 在明确输入集合和公式版本上计算的结果，保留覆盖率及敏感性继承。
entities.lifecycle: immutable formula execution on explicit source set; recompute new version
unknown_fields: per-game minutes rounding and non-additive metrics

entities.definition: 某主体在某时点的能力、倾向、徽章、健康、训练或教练配置等类型化观察。
entities.lifecycle: append typed observations; valid interval only where evidenced
unknown_fields: fatigue, morale, injury dynamics and settings effects vary by field evidence

entities.definition: 世界内已观察到的原生战术本内容版本；不以篮球研究知识替代原生指令。
entities.lifecycle: versioned observed native book content; assignment distinct from static tactics research
unknown_fields: CRC semantics, coach binding, reload persistence

entities.definition: 球队赛季及可选对手范围内的战术配置观察；配置不证明比赛效果。
entities.lifecycle: team/opponent scoped observation versions; effect unknown without evidence
unknown_fields: observed configuration does not prove gameplay effect

entities.definition: 一次采集内的有界原生对象字节或安全摘要，具有布局版本和批次局部定位。
entities.lifecycle: immutable bounded capture-local bytes/summary; restricted raw access
unknown_fields: layout/build and bounds may be unknown; no live reading in this task

entities.definition: 在明确原生命名空间和有效范围内，将原生标识映射到业务对象的证据断言。
entities.lifecycle: candidate -> verified/ambiguous/rejected/expired; scope and evidence retained
unknown_fields: native ID lifetime is never presumed global

entities.definition: 使用指定 Decoder 对某原生对象生成的一次字段断言；身份未解时不进入事实层。
entities.lifecycle: immutable decoded assertion; corrected by another assertion
unknown_fields: unresolved identity remains observation only, not canonical entity

entities.definition: 版本化解码代码、布局与字段语义说明；可共享的静态程序资源。
entities.lifecycle: immutable code/layout hash release; version not auto-acceptance
unknown_fields: research decoder is not production-certified

entities.definition: 封存批次的来源、产物哈希、覆盖度、脱敏与发布一致性证明清单。
entities.lifecycle: sealed per publication cohort; cross-file hashes and masking evidence
unknown_fields: new physical cohort design reserved for SCHEMA/PUBLISH

entities.definition: 对来源、身份、关系、统计或权限问题的可追溯质量记录。
entities.lifecycle: append issues/findings and scoped disposition; original mismatch retained
unknown_fields: passed formula cannot certify all native source semantics

entities.definition: 世界内 GM、Coach 或 Player 的角色及主体绑定，不规定人格算法。
entities.lifecycle: role binding within one save; memory retained in that save only
unknown_fields: future personality/runtime not implemented here

entities.definition: 按角色、世界、时间和策略裁剪后的事实视图快照。
entities.lifecycle: immutable role-safe view snapshot; explicit as-of and source set
unknown_fields: visibility of future role fields needs separate product acceptance

entities.definition: 角色基于其观察作出的分析、意愿、提案或记忆；始终为 AI 来源。
entities.lifecycle: draft -> proposed -> accepted/rejected/withdrawn; all AI provenance
unknown_fields: AI memory never inherits from another save or template

entities.definition: 真人对明确意向、批次、技术绑定和摘要的具体批准。
entities.lifecycle: explicit Human grant -> used/revoked/expired; stale binding rejected
unknown_fields: approval cannot authorize unsupported operation

entities.definition: 一次获批执行尝试及其前像、状态、故障与恢复凭据。
entities.lifecycle: prepared -> applying -> complete/partial/unrecovered; durable preimages
unknown_fields: no write implemented/run here; incomplete outcome requires recovery

entities.definition: 对执行后实际游戏状态的观察；内存回读和 Save/Reload 证明独立记录。
entities.lifecycle: one or more post-attempt observations; persistence separate
unknown_fields: memory match alone does not prove gameplay or Save/Reload

non_table_concepts.ObservationTime: value in CaptureBatch and assertion envelope
non_table_concepts.BoxScore: aggregate revision, may be a view
non_table_concepts.Player: alias of PlayerIncarnation; no extra global person for playing careers
non_table_concepts.Coach: Staff with role binding; not an independent personality implementation
non_table_concepts.AgentMemory: AI records under same-world AgentDecision, no personality algorithm
non_table_concepts.NativeObject: capture instance; layout definition held by DecoderVersion
non_table_concepts.DraftTemplate: global immutable static only, role access not automatic
